visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in a modern indoor living room with warm, bright lighting. Two women sit opposite each other at a clean white table, while a man in a black tank top stands between them. The woman on the left wears glasses and a pink shirt, smiling with a determined expression, while the woman on the right wears a black t-shirt with her face hidden by a stylized cartoon mouse icon. They clasp right hands in a competitive arm-wrestling stance. (2) After a quick victory where the woman on the left pins the other's arm down, the group laughs excitedly. The man gestures dynamically with his hands while speaking. A different woman, her face obscured by a rabbit icon, replaces the first opponent. She places her palm against the woman in glasses to compare hand sizes, highlighting a significant difference. They then begin a second round of arm wrestling, straining their facial muscles and shifting their body weight. (3) In the final phase, the original pairing returns for a rematch. The woman on the left (now wearing a grey shirt) exerts sudden force, pinning the opponent's arm almost instantly. The man points towards the winner with an amused expression. The video concludes with a black screen featuring white text instructions for a YouTube search, while the background depicts a blurred studio environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-arousal male voice kicks off the audio with a sharp, rhythmic shout: "Ready... Go!" This is immediately followed by a bouncy, high-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM with a driving beat. We hear several distinct layers of female laughter, ranging from medium-pitched giggles to high-pitched shrieks. A dull thudding impact sound signifies the arm hitting the table. (2) The acoustic texture shifts to focused dialogue. Female voices engage in rapid-fire speech with a curious tone while discussing hand sizes, accompanied by melodic, playful synth flourishes. The male voice maintains a professional yet comedic narrative tone, occasionally breaking into loud laughter that peaks in volume. Transient 'whoosh' sound effects are used to mark visual transitions. (3) The final phase features a loud vocal countdown followed by a burst of high-arousal screaming and cheering. The male voice becomes highly authoritative, shouting encouragement. A synthesized applause track fades in as the BGM swells slightly in volume before a quick fade-out. The spectral brightness remains high throughout due to the crisp high-frequency content of the laughter and electronic drums.
